results.ask: What's special about my block? I'm on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega.
results.expect: calls about_block; gives the block's own figures and something pinned nearby, with sources; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level, and most of the homes were built around 1941 [DataSF](https://data.sf.gov). Like every block in the area, yours is built on a thick layer of dune sand [USGS](https://pubs.usgs.gov/pp/0782/report.pdf).

A few things nearby:
* **Patriotic Homes:** Two blocks east, builders gave model homes hopeful names during WWII, like the Rainbow House (1941) and Freedom House (1942) [Doelger Architecture](https://www.outsidelands.org/doelger-types.php).
* **Shipwrecks:** About 0.3 miles southwest, the hull of the clipper ship *King Philip* (wrecked 1878) is buried in the sand and occasionally surfaces after winter storms [NPS](https://home.nps.gov/goga/learn/historyculture/vestiges-shipwrecks.htm).
* **Old Photos:** The [OpenSFHistory](https://opensfhistory.org) archive has photographs pinned right at your corner of 46th and Moraga.

Do you know any other stories about your block? I can add them to the notes.

Street cleaning on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega is:

*   **East side:** 1st and 3rd Mondays, noon to 2pm (next: Nov 16)
*   **West side:** 1st, 3rd, and 5th Thursdays, noon to 2pm (next: Nov 19)

These are from the [SF street sweeping schedule](https://data.sf.gov/d/yhqp-riqs), but the signs on the block are the last word.
